title: CESM2 matched reconstruction: concise English comparison snapshot

validation_protocol.target: CESM2 climatological anomaly at each Argo profile location; RMSE equals absolute-state RMSE after adding the common climatology.
validation_protocol.normalization: Train-only depth-variable scale and offset, inherited old synthetic protocol.
validation_protocol.metric_computation: Physical RMSE recomputed against the common canonical float64 validation truth. All prediction identifiers, missing masks, float32 target identity, and exact normalization are verified.
validation_protocol.aggregation: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of three independently trained seeds at each validation-selected checkpoint; not the metric of ensemble predictions.
validation_protocol.pending_rule: No partial seed average is published in main table. A family remains pending until all three runs complete 15000 steps.
validation_protocol.parameter_count_note: Allocated model parameters, including bypassed ablation modules; not active FLOPs.
